note: Quality gate. Keys ending in _ms are maximums; all others are minimums. 'offline' is set just below the 2026-11-17 baseline on the two-document corpus (Act + General Regulations, 80 questions) with stand-in models: hit 0.897, MRR 0.770, answer 0.956, citation 0.739, decline 0.667. The Act-only baseline was hit 0.896, MRR 0.842, citation 0.844, decline 0.800; adding the Regulations lowered it because they restate many sections of the Act. 'live' values are starting points until the first real-model run.
